rule: GOAL: Navigate the character from the start to the target cell. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the character one step in the chosen direction. RULE: Only walkable floor tiles could be entered; walls blocked all movement. TRAP: Believing the decorative magenta border was a countdown timer wasted time.

GOAL: Match the five pink columns to their specific target colors. CONTROLS: Left and Right arrows move the cursor; Up and Down arrows cycle the selected column's color. RULE: Colors rotate in a fixed seven-step loop; choose the shortest direction to reach the target. TRAP: Assuming only one direction works wastes moves; checking both clockwise and counter-clockwise distances saves actions.

GOAL: Grow the green bar until its tip touches the plus marker. CONTROLS: Clicking the right glyph cell extends the bar; the left cell shrinks it. RULE: The bar grows by three units per click, aiming for the distance to the target. TRAP: Thinking glyph orientation dictated direction; position along the axis determined whether it grew or shrank.

GOAL: Use the paddle to catch the falling blob and guide it into the cup. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the paddle left or right; spacebar starts the drop. RULE: The blob spreads wide upon impact, so center the paddle carefully to direct flow. TRAP: Assuming the ball bounces like in Pong; it actually pours down, requiring precise positioning.

GOAL: Slide the gap in the wall to align with the arrow. CONTROLS: Clicking the wall shifts the gap; clicking the arrow moves it. RULE: The gap moves in the opposite direction of the arrow. TRAP: Assuming clicking the gray floor does nothing; it was a distraction.

GOAL: Match the display pattern to the target image shown on screen. CONTROLS: Clicking a dial toggles its top segment; clicking the stem toggles the bottom. RULE: The target image defines exactly which dials should be lit in the final state. TRAP: Assuming complex spatial alignment was needed instead of simply matching the binary on/off state.

GOAL: Align the yellow shaft with the gap in the lower wall. CONTROLS: Click left to move the shaft left; click right to move it right. RULE: The shaft must pass through the empty gap to exit the gray region. TRAP: Assuming the gray block is static; it actually moves as a rigid unit with the shaft.

GOAL: Guide the purple square along the dotted path until it reaches the circle at the center. CONTROLS: Click any cell on the path to move the square there instantly; clicking off-path does nothing. RULE: You can jump to any reachable path cell, not just adjacent ones, allowing you to skip gaps efficiently. TRAP: Do not assume movement is limited to nearby steps; clicking distant path cells is valid and saves actions.

GOAL: Align the sliding plug with the card's pattern to complete the circuit. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the plug along the track. Clicking the card set the target shape. RULE: The plug must stop exactly where the shape matches the card's visual hint. TRAP: Thinking the plug's position was irrelevant or that direction keys changed the pattern itself.

GOAL: Match bottom symbols to the target row by cycling each column. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; UP rotates the current column’s symbols. RULE: Each column cycles through a fixed sequence of shapes independent of others. TRAP: Assuming all columns share the same rotation order wastes moves; probe each column’s specific cycle.

GOAL: Extend colored bars to cover specific target cells. CONTROLS: Click right side of a color to extend it. RULE: Extensions push other bars right; collisions halt progress. TRAP: Assuming bars grow independently ignores displacement effects.

GOAL: Match the card’s dot pattern on the keypad to advance the plug. CONTROLS: Click keypad cells to toggle them; use arrows to move the plug. RULE: Correctly matching the card’s pattern teleports the plug to the next chamber. TRAP: Assuming arrow keys alone move the plug through narrow passages wastes time; keypad success is required to jump between chambers.

ESTABLISHED: Avatar top is row 30. Arm spans rows 32-33. Target row is 37. Block N sits at row 37, column 30. Blocks R and b are jammed at columns 42-45, rows 13 and 19. FAILED: Dragging N vertically while unjammed. Extending the arm to grab N from column 30 pushes N rightward to column 42 instead of lifting it. GOAL IS NOT: Simply pushing all blocks into the rightmost column or leaving N in the target row. CONTROLS: DOWN moves avatar to row 38. RIGHT pushes unjammed blocks east until they hit a wall. UP drags jammed blocks vertically.

GOAL: Align three plugs simultaneously by routing fluid through a five-tank chain. CONTROLS: Click switches to pump fluid from one tank to the next in the sequence. RULE: Fluid levels must match target heights exactly for all connected plugs at the same time. TRAP: Assuming partial alignment triggers a win; intermediate matches do not count, only the final simultaneous state works.

ESTABLISHED: The head drops charcoal at (9,8). Moving left along row 10 is clear. The head can lift a frame when standing directly below it. FAILED: Moving down from (8,8) into the charcoal block is a rotation-only no-op, not a movement. GOAL IS NOT: Simply dropping the first frame at (7,8) clears the level. CONTROLS: SPACE drops or lifts frames. Arrow keys move the head; blocked directions rotate the stripe.

GOAL: Place all three frames into the container. CONTROLS: Arrows move the head; Space picks up or drops the attached frame. RULE: The head always drags the frame one step in the opposite direction. TRAP: Pressing a direction against a wall rotates the head without moving, wasting a turn.

GOAL: Slip past the sleeping guard to reach the exit on the far side. CONTROLS: Arrows move your character one step in the chosen direction. RULE: The guard charges two spaces left if you stand in his row within range. TRAP: Thinking the guard tracks you; his charge is fixed left, so stepping onto his tile is safe if he moves away.

GOAL: Arrange four colored blocks into matching slots to clear the level. CONTROLS: Click a color in the palette to select it, then click a slot to place it. RULE: Match the specific color sequence shown at the top of the screen. TRAP: Assuming slot order was flexible; placing colors in the wrong sequence caused immediate failure.

GOAL: Merge two sliding pieces into a larger one to reach the target. CONTROLS: Click near a piece to slide it six units toward your cursor. RULE: Pieces merge instantly if you click within six units of both at once. TRAP: Assuming you must align them perfectly first; moving closer before merging saves time.

GOAL: Match the yellow target sequence by rotating the blue dial at each position. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; UP rotates the dial to the next class in the cycle. RULE: Each position holds exactly one class from the seven-class blue alphabet, independent of others. TRAP: Assuming you could move left or skip cells; you must solve left-to-right without backtracking.

GOAL: Reach the exit while navigating around stationary guards without being caught in their line of sight. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step in the chosen direction. RULE: Guards only react to players in the exact same row, regardless of distance or column alignment. TRAP: Assuming guards threaten adjacent columns or diagonal paths wastes moves; only horizontal alignment matters.

GOAL: Collect all colored dots using a sliding cross shape to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cross center; Space switches active color. RULE: Only dots matching the active color are collected when touched by the cross arms. TRAP: Assuming all dots must be collected regardless of color wastes time switching unnecessarily.

GOAL: Move the last peg to the center by jumping over others. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click a valid landing spot. RULE: You must jump directly over an adjacent peg into an empty space. TRAP: Thinking you can move freely; every move requires a jump over another piece.

GOAL: Match each panel’s inner mini pattern to its outer cell colors to solve the puzzle. CONTROLS: Click a cell to toggle its color between red and blue, updating the mini display. RULE: The central mini grid must perfectly mirror the surrounding outer grid’s pattern for every panel. TRAP: Assuming the mini grid shows a target to copy; it actually reflects the current outer state.

GOAL: Place items to match the target sequence in two containers. CONTROLS: Click to place items; Space to verify the arrangement. RULE: The target sequence splits by capacity, filling the first container before the second. TRAP: Assuming the target order matches the placement order within each container individually.

GOAL: Match the main grid's colors to the pattern shown in the small reference icon. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to toggle their color between blue and orange. RULE: The reference icon defines the target state; green marks blue, white marks orange. TRAP: Assuming the center of the reference icon dictates the center cell's color; it is merely a visual marker.

GOAL: Rotate the colored ring until specific slots align with the target arrows. CONTROLS: Clicking a side button rotates the entire ring one step in that direction. RULE: The puzzle ends when the ring’s pattern perfectly matches the static side indicators. TRAP: Believing you must click individual dots to change their color; only global rotation works.

GOAL: Merge two separate squares into the single shared center block. CONTROLS: Arrows move both squares simultaneously; they mirror horizontally. RULE: Pieces occupy the same cell to merge; blocked moves leave pieces stationary. TRAP: Assuming pieces block each other prevents the required overlap.

GOAL: Match the target color sequence by filling red slots and inserting green and blue containers into their matching ports. CONTROLS: Click palette colors, then click empty slots or container interiors; press space to submit. RULE: Insert containers into ports of the same color; the sequence reads left-to-right across the combined layout. TRAP: Assuming ports are just placeholders; they actually define where container slots appear in the final sequence order.

GOAL: Cover three scattered dots with a diamond-shaped cursor. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; Space activates the cover. RULE: Dots are caught if the cursor covers them, regardless of path. TRAP: Thinking you must visit each dot individually; one final position can cover multiple dots at once.

GOAL: Push the ball into the target ring. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player; clicks interact with objects. RULE: The player cannot enter the right room; use clicks to move the ball. TRAP: Walking into the left ring does not teleport you or solve the puzzle.

GOAL: Arrange seven colored pieces to match a specific color sequence. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select, then click container slots to place them; press space to confirm. RULE: The empty port piece occupies a slot but does not count as a sequence color, bridging the gap. TRAP: Assuming the port piece contributes its own color to the sequence, causing a mismatch in the final count.

GOAL: Match the pattern by painting cells orange to mirror the mini-legend. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell toggles its color between red and orange. RULE: Mini-markers define which colors fill their surrounding area; the center dot is just a legend. TRAP: Thinking the mini-center needs clicking; it is inert, so ignore it and paint only the surrounding cells.

GOAL: Arrange tiles so the expanded sequence matches the target pattern. CONTROLS: Click palette items to fill red slots, then use space to test the result. RULE: Ports expand into the blue container’s contents, meaning blue items appear twice in the final sequence. TRAP: Assuming all tiles appear once; odd counts must come from fixed red slots, not the expanding blue ones.

GOAL: Collect the scattered plus symbols to transform the locked exit into an open path. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one step across the grid. RULE: Every collectible must be gathered before the exit becomes accessible. TRAP: Assuming the exit opens after just one item; missing hidden pluses leaves the door sealed.

GOAL: Position the purple square at the center of the target ring. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell moves the white diamond there; clicking the gray diamond swaps their positions. RULE: The square always sits exactly midway between the white and gray diamonds. TRAP: Placing the white diamond on the ring does not win; only the square triggers completion.

GOAL: Build a nested structure where three color-coded ports fill the main container, then complete each sub-container with matching pairs. CONTROLS: Click palette pieces to select, click slots to place, press space to confirm the final arrangement. RULE: The order of ports in the main container dictates the sequence of the entire output; read the target string left to right. TRAP: Assuming sub-container contents are interchangeable; they are not, because each port defines a specific, ordered segment of the final result.

GOAL: Reduce the board to a single peg by merging two pieces into one. CONTROLS: Arrow keys drive the truck along the pipe; clicks select a peg to jump. RULE: A peg jumps over an adjacent peg into an empty space, removing the jumped piece. TRAP: Assuming the truck delivers the peg to the room; it actually stays on the pipe, requiring you to jump the truck’s peg into the room.

GOAL: Cover all marked spots using moving shapes. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space cycles to the next shape. RULE: Each shape covers a distinct geometric pattern from its current position. TRAP: Assuming Space cycles only between two shapes; a third shape exists and must be selected before moving.

GOAL: Assemble nested containers to match a specific color sequence. CONTROLS: Click palette pieces to place them into container slots. RULE: Ports inside containers expand to reveal the next nested set of slots. TRAP: Assuming ports go in the middle slot; placing the port in the third slot of the inner container was required to align the final colors.

GOAL: Turn every visible tile to its assigned color before the timer runs out. CONTROLS: Click a tile to cycle it blue, red, then orange, then back to blue. RULE: Each click costs two pixels of time, so plan the shortest cycle for every tile. TRAP: Assuming all tiles need two clicks wastes time; some only need one or zero.

GOAL: Move both mirrored pieces to the center and merge them into a single entity. CONTROLS: Arrows move both pieces simultaneously, but left and right inputs reverse for the right piece. RULE: Pieces merge only when they occupy the exact same cell at the same time. TRAP: Assuming pieces pass through each other like ghosts; they actually block or merge upon contact.

GOAL: Move yellow blocks into marked slots. CONTROLS: Red arrows shift lines one step left; green arrows shift right. RULE: Shared cells allow blocks to transfer between the outer ring and inner rows. TRAP: Trying to align both yellows using only ring rotation fails due to fixed spacing.

ESTABLISHED: The map layout, including the button and door locations, is fixed. The ghost replays a recorded path. The door remains closed until the button is pressed. FAILED: Simple waiting caused a collision with the ghost returning to the start. Direct paths were blocked by the ghost's position or the closed door. GOAL IS NOT: Pressing the button yourself or reaching the door before the ghost completes its sequence. CONTROLS: Moves advance time and the ghost's replay. Staying put or invalid moves also advance the turn.

GOAL: Reach the exit while avoiding a replaying ghost and opening a door. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move you; each press advances the ghost's recorded path. RULE: The ghost presses a button to open the door only after completing its loop. TRAP: Assuming you can press the button yourself; only the ghost can, forcing you to wait.

GOAL: Move the handle to guide the orange square into the target ring. CONTROLS: Click a handle to grab it; click a new location to move it, shifting the square's position based on all handle placements. RULE: The square sits at the average center of all handles, so positioning handles strategically guides it home. TRAP: Assuming water blocks the square's path; it only restricts where you can place a handle, not the route taken.

GOAL: Move the yellow and orange tokens to their target zones. CONTROLS: Left and right buttons shift the left and right token strips. RULE: Tokens are fixed in the strips; you must align strip positions to hit targets. TRAP: Believing the timer drains only per click; it also drains with real time, so hesitate less.

GOAL: Reach the exit by opening a locked door that requires two separate button presses. CONTROLS: Arrows move your character; Space records and replays a ghost to hold a button. RULE: Ghosts replay their exact recorded path and stop at the final position, keeping doors open. TRAP: Assuming one ghost can press both buttons; you must record two distinct paths sequentially.

GOAL: Align the plug’s prongs with the socket to complete the circuit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug; Space rotates it clockwise. RULE: Rotate three times from the starting orientation so prongs face east. TRAP: Believing you must move the plug right; it was already aligned, just facing the wrong way.

GOAL: Navigate the mirrored pair through the central barrier without overlapping. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both shapes in opposite directions simultaneously. RULE: One shape is the reflection of the other across the vertical center line. TRAP: Assuming independent movement wastes time; you must coordinate them as a single symmetric system.

GOAL: Move the wall segment to connect the yellow plug and bar, completing the circuit. CONTROLS: Click blue blocks to toggle the wall’s position; click other spots had no effect. RULE: Only blue blocks move the barrier; aligning yellow segments closes the loop. TRAP: Thinking direct clicks on yellow or background would move pieces; only blue switches worked.

GOAL: Align the plug with the green target by shifting boundaries. CONTROLS: Clicks above or below bars moved adjacent section edges in opposite directions. RULE: Pushing one boundary right forces the neighboring one left, requiring paired adjustments. TRAP: Believing you could push the lower boundary indefinitely without first creating space in the middle section.

GOAL: Reach the exit by moving your character across the grid. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your piece exactly two spaces in a straight line. RULE: You must jump over exactly one non-wall object or empty space to land on a valid open cell. TRAP: Trying to move one space results in a wasted action; you cannot slide, only leap.

ESTABLISHED: The core is trapped in the bottom-right zone. The red wire connects upward to the spark zone. FAILED: Moving the core into the spark zone. The spark region acts as a solid wall. GOAL IS NOT: Placing the core in the spark zone or moving it through the red wire to the top. CONTROLS: Arrows move the core. The core passes through empty space and red wires but is blocked by the spark zone.

GOAL: Align five bottom pink symbols to match their designated blue partners from the reference grid. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the cursor between slots; pressing Up cycled the current symbol through its available variants. RULE: Each blue symbol uniquely defines one correct pink partner, requiring you to match them exactly. TRAP: Assuming a single press cycles through all shapes; rotation states often create distinct variants that must be cycled through separately.

GOAL: Drop the plug exactly into the socket below. CONTROLS: Click switch parts to toggle color; click the blob to release the plug. RULE: The plug falls one cell for each fully black switch. TRAP: Thinking partial switches count or that one switch moves the plug multiple cells.

GOAL: Align the charcoal piece exactly over the yellow target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the piece; Space toggled the movement mode. RULE: The piece shifts three units per arrow press, but the direction mirrors if the mode is flipped. TRAP: Assuming the black shape was a static background; it was actually a mirrored piece that blocked the path.

GOAL: Match seven yellow letter classes to the sequence encoded by four fixed pink glyphs. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the cursor horizontally; up arrow cycled the yellow slot under the cursor. RULE: Pink letters mapped to specific sequences of yellow classes; the cursor only edited yellow slots. TRAP: Assuming the pink row was editable or that slots needed independent rotation fixes rather than class matching.

GOAL: Align and place two distinct blocks into their respective slots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the character; Space attaches or releases a block directly below the head. RULE: Blocks can only be picked up or dropped when positioned directly beneath the character. TRAP: Pressing Space when a block is already attached detaches it; ensure the block is correctly aligned before releasing.

GOAL: Guide the energy core to the yellow bulb. CONTROLS: Arrows move the core; clicking a color icon swaps that block's position. RULE: The core cannot pass through solid blocks, but can enter matching colored blocks to be transported. TRAP: Assuming the yellow bulb is empty space; it is solid, so the core must stop adjacent to it to win.

ESTABLISHED: Pink token and player occupy black-boxed cells; three plug sets exist at distinct row-column positions. FAILED: Horizontal camera alignment caused column discrepancies; standard grid mapping failed to reconcile plug positions. GOAL IS NOT: A simple static grid; the puzzle requires dynamic vertical-only alignment to resolve positional contradictions. CONTROLS: Movement shifts player position; camera scrolls vertically but remains fixed horizontally, requiring row-based correction.

ESTABLISHED: The container orbits the block, painting a half-plane through the block’s center. The block is fixed at rows 34-43. FAILED: Attempts to pour from the left position to paint the bottom half, as the game does not offer this container position. GOAL IS NOT: Simply matching the top half pattern; the bottom half and pocket cells must also align with the target. CONTROLS: Moving the container changes the pour direction; the pour paints the near half-plane facing the container.

GOAL: Align each slot's hidden value to its matching class name to clear the row. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the cursor between slots; pressing up or down cycled the current slot's value through a fixed sequence. RULE: Each yellow class name mapped to a specific target value; the blue row had to match these targets exactly. TRAP: Assuming values changed randomly or that you could jump between slots directly; you had to walk the cursor and count precise cycles.

GOAL: Navigate to the exit while avoiding a red block that lunges when you share its row or column. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one cell; the red block reacts after your turn. RULE: The red block instantly kills you if you land on its row or column within two cells, unless it is already gone. TRAP: Do not assume the red block is static; it moves toward you when you align, causing instant failure if you are too close.

GOAL: Guide the purple square up the dotted rail to the blue circle. CONTROLS: Clicking a spot on the rail pulls the square toward it in one step. RULE: The square only moves along the visible dotted path, ignoring open space. TRAP: Thinking the top gray area is the target wastes time climbing a dead end.

GOAL: Map blue glyphs to yellow targets using a two-step color chain. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cursor; UP cycles through glyph options. RULE: Blue maps to Pink, then Pink maps to Yellow; follow the pair links. TRAP: Assuming the visual cycle length equals unique letter count; it includes rotations, causing duplicate lookups.

GOAL: Move the player to the target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player; clicks interact with objects. RULE: The goal marker only appears once the player enters the correct area. TRAP: Searching for the target before reaching the zone wastes time; it spawns upon arrival.

GOAL: Align five sliders to specific target positions using paired adjustments. CONTROLS: Click buttons between bars to raise one adjacent slider and lower the other. RULE: Each click moves two sliders by equal amounts in opposite directions. TRAP: Assuming buttons affect only their nearest slider; they always impact the pair.

GOAL: Navigate a grid to destroy three red enemies and reach the exit tile. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one square at a time. RULE: Red enemies lunge two squares forward in their facing direction, killing the player if they land there. TRAP: Thinking you can jump over enemies; you must walk around them, and they block paths until destroyed.

GOAL: Move the yellow square to overlap the blue circle goal. CONTROLS: Click near an object to pull it toward your cursor; undo reverses the last move. RULE: Objects only move if the click is within range; overlapping the blue goal completes the level. TRAP: Believing mixed-color proximity causes a no-op; it actually works if one object is the goal.

GOAL: Arrange four colored blocks into specific slots to match the reference sequence displayed at the top of the screen. CONTROLS: Click a block in the bottom tray to pick it up, then click a highlighted slot in the central box to drop it. RULE: Blocks must be placed in the exact left-to-right order shown in the top row, with each block centered on its slot. TRAP: Assuming any placement order works or misaligning blocks by clicking slot edges instead of centers, which causes rejection and wasted moves.

GOAL: Route the fluid stream into the target cup using the movable bar. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the bar horizontally; spacebar releases the fluid. RULE: The fluid spreads across the bar's surface before dripping off the overhanging edge. TRAP: Assuming the bar must be centered under the source; it actually needs to be positioned so the right edge overhangs toward the cup.

GOAL: Guide two large blocks to specific target zones using limited actions. CONTROLS: Click near a block to slide it incrementally toward the click location. RULE: Blocks move in straight lines until blocked or reaching the intended stop point. TRAP: Assuming diagonal movement is possible; clicks only trigger horizontal or vertical slides, requiring separate steps for each axis.

GOAL: Extend the green bar to touch the red plus sign. CONTROLS: Clicking the right arrow grows the bar; the left arrow shrinks it. RULE: The level ends only when the bar physically overlaps the target symbol, not just when adjacent. TRAP: Stopping when the bar is near the target wastes turns; you must grow until the shapes intersect.

GOAL: Collect all blue dots using the blue cross. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active cross; Space switches control to the yellow cross. RULE: Blue arms only collect blue dots, yellow arms only collect yellow dots. TRAP: Assuming one cross could collect both colors wastes moves; switch controls to match the dot color.

GOAL: Guide the shrinking cap through the narrow wire to the socket. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cap; keypad patterns compress and shift it left. RULE: The cap must shrink to fit the thin wire section before passing. TRAP: Assuming the cap’s size is static wastes actions trying to force it through.

GOAL: Shrink the cap to pass a narrow vertical channel and reach the top socket. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cap; clicking keypad cells toggles its size. RULE: The cap must be small to fit through the blocked section, then large or small fits the socket. TRAP: Thinking you need to grow the cap to reach the socket; keeping it small is sufficient to win.

GOAL: Position the white bead so its midpoint with the fixed gray bead aligns with the ring center. CONTROLS: Click empty space to move the white bead; click a bead to swap positions. RULE: The purple marker always sits exactly halfway between the white and gray beads. TRAP: Thinking any click moves the gray bead; it stays put until directly clicked.

GOAL: Collect all orange dots by positioning the X shape. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space cycles to the next shape. RULE: The X’s diagonal arms collect dots only when aligned perfectly with them. TRAP: Assuming shapes block each other; they only overlap visually, not physically.

GOAL: Rotate the ring to move the yellow block into the yellow frame. CONTROLS: Click the red arrow to rotate counter-clockwise; click the green arrow to rotate clockwise. RULE: The yellow frame marks the target slot; only exact alignment clears the level. TRAP: Assuming clicks move the frame; the frame is fixed, and you must move the block to it.

GOAL: Move the fluid to the target cup. CONTROLS: Click to select, arrows to move, space to test. RULE: Only one bar can be active blue at a time. TRAP: Moving a red bar turns it blue, disabling the previous one.

GOAL: Arrange four colored pieces into specific target slots to complete the sequence. CONTROLS: Click a piece to pick it up, then click a destination slot to place it. Press space to submit the solution. RULE: Placing a piece on an occupied slot swaps their positions, allowing you to cycle pieces without emptying the board first. TRAP: Assuming you must clear a slot before moving a piece into it. Trying to find empty space first wastes moves; just swap directly.

GOAL: Position the four-block cap to align its center with the narrow channel leading to the target. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the cap; clicking the keypad triggered a signal pulse. RULE: The pulse only travels if the cap is perfectly centered within the channel's entrance. TRAP: Believing the pulse would broadcast widely regardless of position; it requires precise alignment.

GOAL: Route seven letters through red, green, and blue pipes into their matching target slots to clear the level. CONTROLS: Click a tray letter then click a slot to place it; press the spacebar to activate the flow mechanism. RULE: Follow the pipe color: green and blue boxes fill left-to-right, while red slots fill in sequence along the top path. TRAP: Assuming pipe entry points dictate fill order wastes time; always fill side boxes left-to-right regardless of where the pipe connects.

GOAL: Sort seven scattered shapes into two color-coded boxes using a single outlet slot. CONTROLS: Click a piece in the tray, then click a specific box slot to place it. RULE: The outlet determines the fill order; pieces must match the box's color sequence. TRAP: Assuming the outlet is fixed; it actually moves to the tray, letting you choose the starting slot.

GOAL: Route water streams to three specific cups by positioning barriers. CONTROLS: Arrows shift selected barriers; clicks select targets; space validates solution. RULE: Barriers only deflect streams hitting their active span; empty columns pass through. TRAP: Assuming clicked bars move instantly; they remain static until arrow keys are pressed.

GOAL: Move yellow blocks to fill the two target frames on the right. CONTROLS: Click red arrows to shift tracks left; click green arrows to shift tracks right. RULE: Each arrow moves its entire row or column by one cell, wrapping around the edges. TRAP: Assuming clicks affect only one block; they actually shift the whole track, displacing everything else.

GOAL: Sort colored pieces into matching boxes, using a special ring piece to unlock the outlet sequence. CONTROLS: Click tray pieces then box slots to place them; press Space to validate the arrangement. RULE: The ring piece defines the outlet position, forcing the sequence to flow from that specific slot outward. TRAP: Assuming the ring acts like a standard solid piece; it requires a distinct click target due to its hollow shape.

ESTABLISHED: The player is stuck at the rail's top, unable to reach the necessary height to interact with the red block. The bar cannot push the red block down from this position. FAILED: Attempting to move up to a higher position was blocked or ineffective, leaving the red block immovable. GOAL IS NOT: Simply aligning the bar with the red block at the current player height, as interaction is physically impossible there. CONTROLS: Up moves the player vertically; Left retracts the bar. Up from the rail top fails to reach the required upper row.

GOAL: Place six solid pieces into red and blue boxes while using two blue rings as connectors. CONTROLS: Click to place pieces or rings; press space to reset the level. RULE: Rings consume a red box slot but route the sequence into the blue box, allowing the blue box’s three pieces to be read twice. TRAP: Assuming each ring only fills one unique target; rings actually duplicate the blue box sequence to satisfy the nine targets.

GOAL: Position two blocks to bracket the central notch, bridging the arch. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both blocks simultaneously in mirrored directions. RULE: Symmetry dictates that left presses move the left block left and the right block right. TRAP: Assuming blocks can overlap or ignore the notch's physical barrier wastes moves trying to merge them.

GOAL: Place line, X, and diamond to cover eight transient dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move shapes; Space cycles selection. RULE: Dots reappear, so all three shapes must rest on their targets simultaneously. TRAP: Believing collected dots stay gone; you must position every shape over its specific dots at the same time.

ESTABLISHED: The block fits the corridor. Rotating it to match the top box shape caused a flash but no level clear. The box interior remains static upon matching. FAILED: Simply matching the shape at the box. Moving the block to cover the plus symbol. Pushing the block into the corridor end without specific alignment. GOAL IS NOT: Just matching the shape color. Just covering the floor marker. Just reaching the corridor end. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block. Rotation keys spin the block.
